text:
sara: Heads up — we just saw invoice-preview spikes for a couple of tenants using streaming + batch hybrid calls. digging in, it looks like requests change `session_mode` mid-session (stream -> batch) which splits attribution across two route_ids and doubles token counts in the preview. :confused:

 dinesh: Ugh. Can you paste a sample event? link to console log?

 sara: paste below (redacted tenant):
```
{"request_id":"r_abc123","tenant":"t-xyz","route_id":"routes/v1/fast","session_mode":"stream","tokens":120}
...later...
{"request_id":"r_abc123","tenant":"t-xyz","route_id":"routes/v1/fast-batch","session_mode":"batch","tokens":110}
```

 margot: So the route resolver is emitting a different `route_id` when mode flips. billing joiner currently keys by (tenant, session_id) but the preview agg window uses route_id too. we end up double-counting because previews group by route.

 julian: Two obvious fixes: 1) upstream: add stable `billing_route_id` that persists for a session (requires route-decider change + proto bump), or 2) downstream: treat different route_ids with same session_id as the same billing unit in the preview aggregator. Which is less risky?

 dinesh: Downstream change seems lower risk for quick mitigation. But it's hacky and we'd need to be careful with Kafka partitioning and joins (we rely on route_id for sharding).

 margot: If we do upstream, proto change like this (proposal):
```proto
message IngestEvent {
  string request_id = 1;
  string tenant = 2;
  string route_id = 3; // existing
  optional string billing_route_id = 4; // new, stable for session
  string session_mode = 5;
  int32 tokens = 6;
}
```
We keep `billing_route_id` optional so older consumers don't break.

 sara: Good. But adding a new field touches 3 teams and requires schema rollout docs + connector compatibility. timeline?

 dinesh: If we do upstream: implement in route-decider -> add logic to sticky billing_route_id per session_id stored in redis (TTL 24h). route-decider owner estimate: 2 days of dev + 1 day of infra + 1 day for bake. Then canary rollout.

 julian: Also need to update ingestion-headers -> Kafka key selection. Right now key = tenant|route_id; changing to tenant|billing_route_id would affect partitioning. That migration needs a double-write period or a rekeying job.

 margot: Alternative smaller iteration: modify the preview aggregator to coalesce route_ids when session_mode flips within the same session window. That is scope-limited to preview pipeline only (no sharding impact). We can ship that as a quick mitigation and then do the upstream stable id for long-term.

 sara: I like mitigation-first. Who can own the preview aggregator patch? @dinesh?

 dinesh: I can take the preview change. Plan: patch aggregator to normalize by session_id if multiple route_ids show up within the same agg window. Add a 1% sample check to avoid perf regressions.

 margot: While we do that, I'll start the proto proposal and compatibility plan for `billing_route_id`. add migration notes for Kafka key transition.

 metering-bot: Created ticket MET-1234: "session_mode flips -> preview double-count" and linked logs.

 sara: Nice. Dashboard/telemetry changes: we need a new panel that breaks invoice-preview by session_mode and billing_route_id (once available). add alert if preview delta > 10% vs ledger for top 50 tenants.

 julian: Also add a debug trace flag `x-debug-billing=true` that flows through requests to mark them in downstream logs for a short canary. keeps traces cheap.

 dinesh: Quick snippet I plan to deploy to preview aggregator (pseudocode):
```js
// in preview-agg reduce
if (events.forSession(session_id).map(e => e.route_id).unique().length > 1) {
  // coalesce under session key instead of route key for this window
  emit(session_key, sum(tokens))
} else {
  emit(route_key, sum(tokens))
}
```

 sara: Good. rollout: patch preview aggregator canary -> 5% tenants for 1 hour, monitor preview-vs-ledger delta and CPU. If stable, ramp to 25% then 100%. document rollback command.

 margot: For the proto work: I'll draft the change and post compatibility checklist: optional field, default to empty, consumers should fallback to route_id if billing_route_id missing. also add a migration RW-mode for kafka key change.

 deploy-bot: shadow-run initiated for preview-agg patch on canary cluster at 6942001260.

 dinesh: Started PR draft: link to diff in thread. adding unit + integration test. will include a feature flag `preview.coalesce_by_session` default off.

 sara: Action items: 1) dinesh -> patch preview agg + canary (MET-1234) 2) margot -> proto + Kafka migration doc + compatibility checklist 3) julian -> add debug trace flag to route-decider 4) sara -> dashboards + alerts update. target: mitigation canary today, proto RFC by EOD tomorrow.

 julian: One more note — telemetry: add a histogram of token delta per session when mode flips, so we can quantify how often this happens. small metric: session_mode_flip_count labeled by tenant.

 sara: Agreed. I'll add that to the dashboard ticket.

 margot: If we go upstream later, we should avoid changing partition key abruptly. propose a migration with dual writing for 48h and a background compaction job to rekey historical events.

 dinesh: ok starting the canary now. ping me if preview delta goes > 15% for any tenant.

 sara: Thanks all — this plan should both mitigate customer-facing spikes and give us a clean long-term design. :thumbsup:
